final_integration.qualification_DTS_change_from_original: Only obsolete reconstruction comment; inherits the integrated ordinary board target
final_integration.style_scope: Whitespace, consistent if/else braces and MAINTAINERS order; behavior preserved

linked_kernel.new_module_private_key: Generated and used by Kbuild; audit checks mode only, never inspects or exports contents

dependencies.scope: Dependency metadata only; signatures, ABI, runtime loading and install hooks separate

historical_fixture_scope.historical_fixture_scope: Pre-aux/pll C model lacks the later struct members and clock stub; unchanged historical model is retained

reviewed_findings.combined_binding_and_driver_diff: Integration checkpoint spans binding and driver commits. Final submission series must keep them separate; no submission-readiness claim.
reviewed_findings.new_file_maintainer_review: Review added helper/header ownership; CPR helper and public headers explicitly covered by MAINTAINERS additions; subsystem ownership retained.
reviewed_findings.per_instance_mutable_regulator_ops: Probe copies the descriptor operations and changes callbacks according to the actual fixed-range provider. A shared const table cannot represent that per-instance copy.
reviewed_findings.voltage_unit_identifiers: Retain uV suffixes used by the existing regulator and CPR interfaces.
reviewed_findings.atomic_CPU0_IPI_settling_delay: The setter runs synchronously in the CPU0 IPI context and must not sleep; source comment states that constraint.

style_review.historical_per_commit_checks: Original descriptions/cherry-pick trailers and intermediate layouts are retained. Initial full-message findings remain in checkpatch.json; they do not pass strict style.

binding_checks.setup_error_reason: Alpine native dtc requests /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1, absent on the Fedora host. Explicit loader/library-path wrapper runs the same compiled binary.

APK_signature_and_simulation.modified_metadata_message: BAD signature; original signature retained and modified control stream recompressed with valid gzip CRC
